description: Alert manager daemon. Polls mesh_events every 300s for severity=CRITICAL or CRITICAL events from zo_sentinel agents. Deduplicates: same server_id+event_type within 1h = skip. For each unique alert: (1) write to corrections table (2) attempt email via api.zo.computer/zo/notify (3) write ALERT_LOG.md entry. Thresholds: new KNOWN_THREAT verdict=CRITICAL, 3+ HIGH_RISK servers in 1h=HIGH, attestation expired+still deployed=HIGH. Tracks alert history in alert_history dict to avoid spam. Heartbeat.
